functions.purpose: ARM EABI __aeabi_i2f / __floatsisf: extract sign, abs, then tail into the shared unsigned normalize/pack at 0x100054f4 (CLZ-style 16/8/4/2/1 shifts). Packs IEEE-754 float as expPosition<<23 plus sign|0x40000000 (bias 128) with round-to-nearest-even on bits 7..0.

immediates.meaning: lsrs #31 extracts the integer sign bit
OR into sign: 128<<23, IEEE bias 127 plus implicit 1
Starting binary exponent 31 before normalize-left
Guard bit and sticky mask for round-to-nearest-even

functions.purpose: ARM FPLIB ldexpf/_fscale pair of ScaleDoubleByPowerTwo: add exponentDelta to a float's biased exponent when the result stays finite/normal. Else signed 0 (underflow), signed Inf 0x7F800000 (overflow), or DAT_10005594=0x7FC00000 qNaN.

immediates.meaning: 8-bit exponent field mask / complement seed
lsrs #23 extracts the biased exponent
exponentDelta<<23 added onto the original float bits
Signed Inf when scaling overflows
Quiet NaN returned for NaN inputs

functions.purpose: ARM C library __ieee_status store half: GetIeeeStatusWordAddress() then write the 32-bit FPLIB status/errno word. Called from soft-float (including after sqrt) in 0x10005xxx.
ARM __rt_fp_status_addr: returns DAT_100055b4=0x20002BAC, first word of the 96-byte __user_libspace (same address as GetUserLibspaceBaseAddress).

immediates.meaning: RAM address of IEEE status / libspace[0]

functions.purpose: ARM FPLIB _dcmp / AEABI cdcmple-style: compare two IEEE-754 doubles in r0-r3, 5th arg ieeeStatus on stack. NaN if (hi<<1) > DAT_10005644=0xFFE00000. If status&0xD0000==0 trap; else unordered flags. Else MRS CPSR / fix N for negatives / MSR APSR.

immediates.meaning: 0x7FF00000<<1: double Inf/NaN exponent after sign-out shift
IEEE status mask: trap vs return-unordered on NaN
N+V mask cleared when rewriting APSR for negative operands
Returns packed NZCV in r0 / writes APSR for AEABI compare

functions.purpose: ARM FPLIB _dsqrt kernel (called by CalculateIeeeDoubleSqrt @ 0x10006520): restoring binary square-root on a nonnegative finite double. +Inf passthrough, −x → DAT_10005744=0x7FF80000 qNaN, ±0 passthrough, denormal → signed 0. Round-to-nearest-even from remainder sticky + guard.

immediates.meaning: Double exponent mask (Inf/NaN / nonzero-exp test)
Quiet NaN high word for negative or invalid sqrt
Hidden 1 inserted into the 52-bit mantissa
Exponent +253 used to pair-odd-exp before digit loops
Initial root and trial-bit seeds for the two restoring loops

functions.purpose: ARM __user_libspace: returns DAT_1000574c=0x20002BAC (96-byte C-library workspace immediately below heap base 0x20002C10).

immediates.meaning: Libspace base; heap follows at 0x20002C10

functions.purpose: ARM __rt_stackheap_init (first BL in __rt_entry @ 0x100010b0): 8-align libspace, temporarily switch SP to libspace+0x60, push {libspace,lr}, call GetUserStackHeapBounds (0x20002C10 / 0x20003210), then STMIA-zero 16 words (64 bytes) of libspace and restore SP.

immediates.meaning: lsrs/lsls #3 8-byte-aligns the libspace pointer
Temporary SP = aligned libspace + 0x60
Eight STMIA {r6,r7} stores zero 64 bytes of libspace

functions.purpose: ARM exit / __rt_exit thunk: called from __rt_entry after main returns (BL 0x100010be). Forwards r0/r1 to CallFiniThenSemihostExit, which ends at HandleSemihostingSysExit.
FPLIB NaN/invalid compare helper. If ieeeStatus bit20 clear → 0. If bits 18..16 of the low 19 bits nonzero → ~(status<<15)<<1. Else MSR APSR to unordered (C+V=0x30000000) keeping Q in bit 27.

immediates.meaning: lsls #11 tests IEEE status bit 20
APSR C|V unordered result of an IEEE compare vs NaN

functions.purpose: ARM _fp_trap entry used when _dcmp sees NaN and ieeeStatus&0xD0000==0: DispatchFloatingPointException(0, DAT_100057dc=0x7FF80000 qNaN, return address).

immediates.meaning: Quiet double NaN passed as the trap operand

functions.purpose: ARM _fp_trapveneer: exceptionCode low nibble 9 → NaN APSR flags; 8/10 with bit6 set → 0x80000000; class 8 otherwise repacks the operand by <<3/>>29 keeping the 0xFF000000 field (FPLIB packed float/exception format).

immediates.meaning: Exception class in the low nibble of exceptionCode
FPLIB trap classes: NaN flags, signed abort, packed-format convert
Forced sign-bit result when class 8/10 and bit6 is set

Bit19 (0x80000): write clear then HaltForeverIfStatusZero(0). Bit1: IncrementOscMeasureCounter + ServiceOscCalibrationPeriodTick, write 0x1000000 to 0x40010040.
